title: TYL's Plushies
description: Adds a variety of decorative plushies.
body:
![1.1 Plushies (excluding alt styles & secret)](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/3f6c56eba22891a37c8b12f858195fb17dd77c5e_0.webp)

TYL's Plushies adds a wide variety of plushies from different media, including games, animation and youtubers, that can be used to decorate your base or carried around in your off-hand.

![  Crafting a Steve plush with a Minecraft Plush Template](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/3a3f298398ea3b39fcc6de3f18fdc423f973a2a9.png)
![All plush templates](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/5146cdc8591688a60b27849270faf914b20f17bd.png)

To make a plushie you'll need to combine some wool and dye with a plush template, which can be made with sticks, string and paper. You can also add a dye to make specific plush templates, which can help with finding a specific recipe with JEI or reducing the number of plushies in your recipe book, as crafting a template unlocks recipes for all plushies in that category.

Certain plushies (currently DanTDM, Hatsune Miku & Kasane Teto) have alternate styles that can be cycled through using with crafting, or by right-clicking with an axe or hoe.

There are also 6 secret plushies obtained in different ways, updated recipes for plushies if Dye Depot is installed, and a translation for the LOLCAT language option!
